icu:cantOpenSignalError__detail:
To help fix the issue, follow the recovery guide on the support page or open an issue in the Vesper repository.

If you need to use Vesper right away, you can delete your data and relink this desktop. You will have the option to transfer message history from your phone.
icu:databaseError__deleteDataConfirmatio:
All of your message history and media will be permanently deleted from this device. This will not delete any data from your phone.

You will be able to use Vesper on this device after relinking it. You will have the option to transfer message history from your phone.
icu:databaseError__startOldVersion: The version of your database does not match this version of Vesper. Make sure you are opening the newest version of Vesper on your computer.
icu:audioPermissionNeeded: To send voice messages, allow Vesper to access your microphone.
icu:audioCallingPermissionNeeded: For calling, you must allow Vesper to access your microphone.
icu:videoCallingPermissionNeeded: For video calling, you must allow Vesper to access your camera.
icu:SafetyNumberViewer__KeyTransparency_: For people you’re connected to by phone number, Vesper can automatically confirm whether the connection is secure using a process called key transparency. For added security, verify end-to-end encryption manually by comparing the numbers on the previous screen or scanning the code on their device.

Vesper cannot automatically verify the encryption for this chat. This could be because {name} changed their phone number or their phone number privacy settings. Verify end-to-end encryption manually by comparing the numbers on the previous screen or scanning the code on their device.

Vesper can only automatically verify the encryption in chats where you’re connected to someone via a phone number. If the chat was started with a username or a group in common, verify end-to-end encryption by comparing the numbers on the previous screen or scanning the code on their device.
icu:KeyTransparencyOnboardingDialog__Des: For contacts you’re connected to by phone number, Vesper can automatically confirm whether the connection is secure using a process called key transparency. For added security, you can still verify connections manually using a QR code or by comparing safety numbers.
icu:ChatRefresh--summary: Vesper uses end-to-end encryption and may need to refresh your chat session sometimes. This doesn’t affect your chat’s security, but you may have missed a message from this contact and can ask them to resend it.
icu:Install__confirm-data-deletion__body: You’re attempting to link a different Signal account to this desktop. If you continue, all data currently in Vesper will be deleted.
icu:Preferences__PrivacyPage__KeyTranspa: When enabled, Vesper will attempt to automatically verify the encryption of one-to-one chats.

icu:Preferences--backup-section-descript: Back up your message history so you never lose data when you get a new phone or reinstall Vesper.
icu:Preferences--local-backups-restore-i: To restore a backup, install a new copy of Vesper on your phone. Open the app and select “Restore or transfer”. <learnMoreLink>Learn more.</learnMoreLink>
icu:Preferences--local-backups-recovery-: This key is required to recover your account and data. Store it somewhere safe and never share it with anyone. Vesper will never message you for your recovery key. <learnMoreLink>Learn more.</learnMoreLink>
icu:CompositionInput__recovery-key-warni: Do not share your recovery key with anyone. Anyone with the key can take over your account. Vesper will never message you for your recovery key. Never respond to a chat pretending to be Vesper. Learn more.
icu:Preferences__local-backups-confirm-k: Vesper will not be able to help you restore your backup if you lose your key. Store it somewhere safe and secure, and do not share it with others.
icu:Preferences__local-backups-auth-erro: System authentication failed. Try again, or open Vesper on your mobile device and go to Backup Settings to view your recovery key.

icu:Preferences__pnp__discoverability--d: Anyone who has your phone number will see you’re on Vesper and can start chats with you.
